name: Filter earthquakes
func: const fs=global.get('fs'); function readCfg(){try{return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/data/shackclock-settings.json','utf8'));}catch(e){return {};}} const C=readCfg(); const V=(k,d='')=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(C,k)?C[k]:((env.get(k)!==undefined&&env.get(k)!==null)?env.get(k):d); const min=Number(V('EARTHQUAKE_MIN_MAG',2.5)); const hrs=Number(V('EARTHQUAKE_MAX_AGE_HOURS',24)); const cutoff=Date.now()-Math.max(1,hrs)*3600000; const d=(msg.payload&&typeof msg.payload==='object')?msg.payload:{type:'FeatureCollection',features:[]}; d.features=(Array.isArray(d.features)?d.features:[]).filter(f=>Number(f?.properties?.mag)>=min && Number(f?.properties?.time)>=cutoff); msg.headers={'content-type':'application/geo+json','cache-control':'no-store'}; msg.payload=d; return msg;
